us_econ: Growth: real GDP 3.4% annualized in 2026-Q3, consumer spending 3.8%. Policy: fed funds target 3.75-4.0% (effective 3.88%); 2-year Treasury 4.73% (+0.85 vs fed funds: market pricing hikes); 10-year breakeven inflation 2.20%, real 10-year 2.78%. For ags: high real yields and a firm dollar weigh on fund demand for commodities; sticky inflation keeps rates high (carry and storage costs up); a weak job market or falling real incomes hits meat and dairy demand first.

energy.read: Gas storage 3,882 Bcf (week to 2026-11-13), +20 Bcf vs a 5-year average -25 for the week; +98 Bcf (+2.6%) vs the 5-year average, -54 vs last year. Crude stocks 417.8 mb (+3.4 mb on the week, -3.7% vs 5-yr avg); gasoline +5.2 mb, distillate +1.6 mb; refinery utilization 95.7%. 3-2-1 crack $41.00/bbl (ULSD $80.73, gasoline $21.13). NG weather/positioning: squeeze risk ELEVATED (2 of 7 cold-risk checks on; managed money net -211,476 (2nd pct of 3 yrs, -54,628 in 4 wks)). GEFS AO week 2 -2.10 (now +0.26); GEFS PNA week 2 +0.74 (western ridge / eastern trough). Cold-pattern signals are present but the models have not turned colder yet. Keep shorts small and in options; switch to HIGH if the 2-3 day trend or weeks 3-4 turn cold. Options: NG IV 84% vs RV 50%; CL IV 45% vs RV 50%; HO IV 50% vs RV 47%; RB IV 44% vs RV 42%. For ags: diesel and natural gas set farm fuel, drying and nitrogen fertilizer costs; crude and gasoline drive ethanol and biodiesel margins (corn, soybean oil).
